title: Selected zones
sql:
WITH demand AS (
    SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 HOUR, timestamp_utc) AS hour, area_eic_code, avg(demand_mw) AS mw
    FROM mart_demand_actual WHERE list_contains($areas, area_eic_code) AND timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY ALL
),
demand_zone AS (SELECT area_eic_code, avg(mw) AS mw FROM demand GROUP BY ALL),
errors AS (
    SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 HOUR, a.timestamp_utc) AS hour, a.area_eic_code, avg(a.demand_mw - f.demand_mw) AS mw
    FROM mart_demand_actual a
    JOIN mart_demand_forecast f
        ON f.timestamp_utc = a.timestamp_utc AND f.area_eic_code = a.area_eic_code AND f.time_horizon = 'day_ahead'
    WHERE list_contains($areas, a.area_eic_code) AND a.timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND a.timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY ALL
),
-- error of the selection's total, over the hours every paired zone reports
hourly_errors AS (
    SELECT hour, sum(mw) AS mw FROM errors GROUP BY hour
    HAVING count(*) = (SELECT count(DISTINCT area_eic_code) FROM errors)
),
generation AS (
    SELECT sum(greatest(g.generation_mw, 0) * g.coverage) AS mwh,
        sum(CASE WHEN t.is_zero_carbon THEN greatest(g.generation_mw, 0) * g.coverage END)
            AS zero_carbon_mwh
    FROM mart_generation_actual g
    LEFT JOIN dim_technology t USING (technology_code)
    WHERE list_contains($areas, g.area_eic_code) AND g.timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND g.timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
),
price AS (
    SELECT sum(price_per_mwh * coverage) / sum(coverage) AS eur
    FROM mart_energy_price WHERE list_contains($areas, area_eic_code) AND source_dataset = 'ENTSOE_12.1.D' AND time_horizon = 'day_ahead' AND coalesce(classification_sequence, 1) = 1 AND currency = 'EUR' AND timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
)
SELECT
    (SELECT round(sum(mw)) FROM demand_zone) AS avg_demand_mw,
    (SELECT round(max(mw)) FROM (SELECT hour, sum(mw) AS mw FROM demand GROUP BY hour)) AS peak_demand_mw,
    (SELECT round(avg(abs(mw))) FROM hourly_errors) AS demand_forecast_mae_mw,
    (SELECT round(mwh / 1000) FROM generation) AS generation_gwh,
    (SELECT round(zero_carbon_mwh / nullif(mwh, 0) * 100, 1) FROM generation) AS zero_carbon_share_pct,
    (SELECT round(eur, 2) FROM price) AS day_ahead_price_eur
description: Headline demand, forecast error, generation, zero-carbon share and day-ahead price of the selected zones over the date range.

title: Bidding zones (click to filter)
sql:
WITH zones AS (
    SELECT area_eic_code, display_name AS zone, long_name AS name
    FROM dim_area WHERE is_current AND is_bidding_zone
),
generation_series AS (
    SELECT g.area_eic_code,
        avg(greatest(g.generation_mw, 0)) AS mw,
        avg(CASE WHEN t.is_zero_carbon THEN greatest(g.generation_mw, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS zero_carbon_mw
    FROM mart_generation_actual g
    LEFT JOIN dim_technology t USING (technology_code)
    WHERE g.timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND g.timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY g.area_eic_code, g.source_dataset, g.source_code, g.border_area_eic_code
),
generation AS (
    SELECT area_eic_code, sum(mw) AS avg_generation_mw, sum(zero_carbon_mw) AS zero_carbon_mw
    FROM generation_series GROUP BY area_eic_code
),
demand AS (
    SELECT area_eic_code, sum(demand_mw * coverage) / sum(coverage) AS avg_demand_mw
    FROM mart_demand_actual WHERE timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY area_eic_code
),
price AS (
    SELECT area_eic_code, sum(price_per_mwh * coverage) / sum(coverage) AS day_ahead_price_eur
    FROM mart_energy_price WHERE source_dataset = 'ENTSOE_12.1.D' AND time_horizon = 'day_ahead' AND coalesce(classification_sequence, 1) = 1 AND currency = 'EUR' AND timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY area_eic_code
)
SELECT z.area_eic_code, z.zone, z.name,
    round(g.zero_carbon_mw / nullif(g.avg_generation_mw, 0) * 100, 1) AS zero_carbon_share_pct,
    round(d.avg_demand_mw) AS avg_demand_mw,
    round(g.avg_generation_mw) AS avg_generation_mw,
    round(p.day_ahead_price_eur, 2) AS day_ahead_price_eur
FROM zones z
LEFT JOIN generation g USING (area_eic_code)
LEFT JOIN demand d USING (area_eic_code)
LEFT JOIN price p USING (area_eic_code)
WHERE coalesce(g.avg_generation_mw, d.avg_demand_mw, p.day_ahead_price_eur) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY z.zone
description: Every bidding zone over the date range, coloured by the chosen metric; click zones to select them as the page's area filter.

title: Market

panels.title: Day-ahead price
panels.sql:
WITH grid AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(
        time_bucket($bucket, $start_date::TIMESTAMP),
        $end_date::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL 1 DAY - INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND,
        $bucket
    )) AS bucket
),
prices AS (
    SELECT time_bucket($bucket, p.timestamp_utc) AS bucket, p.area_eic_code, z.display_name AS series, 'EUR' AS currency,
        sum(p.price_per_mwh * p.coverage) / sum(p.coverage) AS price
    FROM mart_energy_price p
    JOIN dim_area z ON z.area_eic_code = p.area_eic_code AND z.is_current
    WHERE list_contains($areas, p.area_eic_code) AND p.source_dataset = 'ENTSOE_12.1.D' AND p.time_horizon = 'day_ahead' AND coalesce(p.classification_sequence, 1) = 1 AND p.currency = 'EUR' AND p.timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND p.timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY ALL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time_bucket($bucket, timestamp_utc) AS bucket, area_eic_code, 'GB MID (GBP)' AS series, 'GBP' AS currency,
        sum(price_per_mwh * volume_mwh) / nullif(sum(volume_mwh), 0) AS price
    FROM mart_energy_price
    WHERE source_dataset = 'MID' AND list_contains($areas, area_eic_code) AND timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY ALL
),
expected AS (SELECT DISTINCT area_eic_code FROM prices),
coverage AS (
    SELECT g.bucket,
        count(p.area_eic_code) AS zones_reporting,
        count(*) AS zones_expected,
        string_agg(d.display_name, ', ' ORDER BY d.display_name) FILTER (WHERE p.area_eic_code IS NULL)
            AS zones_missing
    FROM grid g
    CROSS JOIN expected e
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT bucket, area_eic_code FROM prices) p
        ON p.bucket = g.bucket AND p.area_eic_code = e.area_eic_code
    LEFT JOIN dim_area d ON d.area_eic_code = e.area_eic_code AND d.is_current
    GROUP BY g.bucket
),
-- up to eight zones: one line each, in selection order; beyond: the EUR zones' mean within their P10-P90 band
many AS (SELECT count(*) > 8 AS many FROM expected),
series AS (
    SELECT bucket, series, round(price, 2) AS price, list_position($areas, area_eic_code) AS series_order
    FROM prices WHERE NOT (SELECT many FROM many)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bucket, 'Mean of EUR zones', round(avg(price), 2), 1 FROM prices
    WHERE currency = 'EUR' AND (SELECT many FROM many) GROUP BY bucket
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bucket, 'P10', round(quantile_cont(price, 0.1), 2), 2 FROM prices
    WHERE currency = 'EUR' AND (SELECT many FROM many) GROUP BY bucket
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bucket, 'P90', round(quantile_cont(price, 0.9), 2), 3 FROM prices
    WHERE currency = 'EUR' AND (SELECT many FROM many) GROUP BY bucket
)
SELECT c.bucket, s.series, s.price, c.zones_reporting, c.zones_expected, c.zones_missing
FROM coverage c LEFT JOIN series s USING (bucket)
ORDER BY s.series_order NULLS LAST, s.series, c.bucket
panels.description: ENTSO-E day-ahead price (first allocation round, EUR) per zone, and GB's Market Index Price (GBP); over eight zones, the EUR zones' mean within their 10th-90th percentile band.

panels.title: Day-ahead - intraday
panels.sql:
WITH grid AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(
        time_bucket($bucket, $start_date::TIMESTAMP),
        $end_date::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL 1 DAY - INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND,
        $bucket
    )) AS bucket
),
prices AS (
    SELECT time_bucket($bucket, p.timestamp_utc) AS bucket, p.area_eic_code, z.display_name AS zone,
        sum(p.price_per_mwh * p.coverage) FILTER (WHERE p.time_horizon = 'day_ahead')
            / sum(p.coverage) FILTER (WHERE p.time_horizon = 'day_ahead') AS day_ahead,
        sum(p.price_per_mwh * p.coverage) FILTER (WHERE p.time_horizon = 'intraday')
            / sum(p.coverage) FILTER (WHERE p.time_horizon = 'intraday') AS intraday
    FROM mart_energy_price p
    JOIN dim_area z ON z.area_eic_code = p.area_eic_code AND z.is_current
    WHERE list_contains($areas, p.area_eic_code) AND p.source_dataset = 'ENTSOE_12.1.D' AND coalesce(p.classification_sequence, 1) = 1
      AND p.currency = 'EUR' AND p.timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND p.timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY ALL
),
spreads AS (SELECT * FROM prices WHERE day_ahead IS NOT NULL AND intraday IS NOT NULL),
expected AS (SELECT DISTINCT area_eic_code FROM spreads),
coverage AS (
    SELECT g.bucket,
        count(p.area_eic_code) AS zones_reporting,
        count(*) AS zones_expected,
        string_agg(d.display_name, ', ' ORDER BY d.display_name) FILTER (WHERE p.area_eic_code IS NULL)
            AS zones_missing
    FROM grid g
    CROSS JOIN expected e
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT bucket, area_eic_code FROM spreads) p
        ON p.bucket = g.bucket AND p.area_eic_code = e.area_eic_code
    LEFT JOIN dim_area d ON d.area_eic_code = e.area_eic_code AND d.is_current
    GROUP BY g.bucket
)
SELECT c.bucket, s.zone AS series, round(s.day_ahead - s.intraday, 2) AS spread_eur, c.zones_reporting, c.zones_expected, c.zones_missing
FROM coverage c LEFT JOIN spreads s USING (bucket)
ORDER BY list_position($areas, s.area_eic_code) NULLS LAST, c.bucket
panels.description: Day-ahead minus intraday (first auction) price per zone, where both are published.

config.empty_message: No intraday prices for the selected zones (ENTSO-E publishes them for ES)

panels.title: Demand vs day-ahead forecast
panels.sql:
WITH grid AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(
        time_bucket($bucket, $start_date::TIMESTAMP),
        $end_date::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL 1 DAY - INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND,
        $bucket
    )) AS bucket
),
zone_buckets AS (
    SELECT time_bucket($bucket, a.timestamp_utc) AS bucket, a.area_eic_code,
        avg(a.demand_mw) AS actual_mw, avg(f.demand_mw) AS forecast_mw
    FROM mart_demand_actual a
    JOIN mart_demand_forecast f
        ON f.timestamp_utc = a.timestamp_utc AND f.area_eic_code = a.area_eic_code AND f.time_horizon = 'day_ahead'
    WHERE list_contains($areas, a.area_eic_code) AND a.timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND a.timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY ALL
),
expected AS (SELECT DISTINCT area_eic_code FROM zone_buckets),
coverage AS (
    SELECT g.bucket,
        count(p.area_eic_code) AS zones_reporting,
        count(*) AS zones_expected,
        string_agg(d.display_name, ', ' ORDER BY d.display_name) FILTER (WHERE p.area_eic_code IS NULL)
            AS zones_missing
    FROM grid g
    CROSS JOIN expected e
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT bucket, area_eic_code FROM zone_buckets) p
        ON p.bucket = g.bucket AND p.area_eic_code = e.area_eic_code
    LEFT JOIN dim_area d ON d.area_eic_code = e.area_eic_code AND d.is_current
    GROUP BY g.bucket
)
SELECT c.bucket, round(sum(z.actual_mw)) AS actual_mw, round(sum(z.forecast_mw)) AS forecast_mw, c.zones_reporting, c.zones_expected, c.zones_missing
FROM coverage c LEFT JOIN zone_buckets z USING (bucket)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY c.bucket
panels.description: Actual demand and its day-ahead forecast, summed over the selected zones publishing both; shaded between them by the sign of the error.

panels.title: Demand forecast error
panels.sql:
WITH grid AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(
        time_bucket($bucket, $start_date::TIMESTAMP),
        $end_date::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL 1 DAY - INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND,
        $bucket
    )) AS bucket
),
zone_buckets AS (
    SELECT time_bucket($bucket, a.timestamp_utc) AS bucket, a.area_eic_code,
        avg(a.demand_mw) AS actual_mw, avg(f.demand_mw) AS forecast_mw
    FROM mart_demand_actual a
    JOIN mart_demand_forecast f
        ON f.timestamp_utc = a.timestamp_utc AND f.area_eic_code = a.area_eic_code AND f.time_horizon = 'day_ahead'
    WHERE list_contains($areas, a.area_eic_code) AND a.timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND a.timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY ALL
),
expected AS (SELECT DISTINCT area_eic_code FROM zone_buckets),
coverage AS (
    SELECT g.bucket,
        count(p.area_eic_code) AS zones_reporting,
        count(*) AS zones_expected,
        string_agg(d.display_name, ', ' ORDER BY d.display_name) FILTER (WHERE p.area_eic_code IS NULL)
            AS zones_missing
    FROM grid g

SELECT c.bucket, round(sum(z.actual_mw - z.forecast_mw)) AS error_mw, c.zones_reporting, c.zones_expected, c.zones_missing

panels.description: Actual minus day-ahead forecast demand of the selected zones.

panels.title: Wind and solar vs forecast
panels.sql:
WITH grid AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(
        time_bucket($bucket, $start_date::TIMESTAMP),
        $end_date::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL 1 DAY - INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND,
        $bucket
    )) AS bucket
),
tech AS (
    SELECT technology_code, ancestor_technology_code AS tech
    FROM bridge_technology_hierarchy WHERE ancestor_technology_code IN ('wind', 'solar')
),
actual AS (
    SELECT bucket, area_eic_code, technology_code, sum(mw) AS mw
    FROM (
        SELECT time_bucket($bucket, timestamp_utc) AS bucket, area_eic_code, technology_code,
            avg(greatest(generation_mw, 0)) AS mw
        FROM mart_generation_actual WHERE list_contains($areas, area_eic_code) AND timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
        GROUP BY bucket, area_eic_code, technology_code, source_dataset, source_code
    ) GROUP BY ALL
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT time_bucket($bucket, timestamp_utc) AS bucket, area_eic_code, technology_code, avg(generation_mw) AS mw
    FROM mart_generation_forecast WHERE list_contains($areas, area_eic_code) AND timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND time_horizon = 'day_ahead'
    GROUP BY ALL
),
-- actual and day-ahead forecast paired per zone and technology (onshore, offshore, solar)
zone_buckets AS (
    SELECT bucket, area_eic_code,
        sum(a.mw) FILTER (WHERE t.tech = 'wind') AS wind_mw,
        sum(f.mw) FILTER (WHERE t.tech = 'wind') AS wind_forecast_mw,
        sum(a.mw) FILTER (WHERE t.tech = 'solar') AS solar_mw,
        sum(f.mw) FILTER (WHERE t.tech = 'solar') AS solar_forecast_mw
    FROM actual a JOIN forecast f USING (bucket, area_eic_code, technology_code) JOIN tech t USING (technology_code)
    GROUP BY ALL
),
expected AS (SELECT DISTINCT area_eic_code FROM zone_buckets),
coverage AS (
    SELECT g.bucket,
        count(p.area_eic_code) AS zones_reporting,
        count(*) AS zones_expected,
        string_agg(d.display_name, ', ' ORDER BY d.display_name) FILTER (WHERE p.area_eic_code IS NULL)
            AS zones_missing
    FROM grid g
    CROSS JOIN expected e
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT bucket, area_eic_code FROM zone_buckets) p
        ON p.bucket = g.bucket AND p.area_eic_code = e.area_eic_code
    LEFT JOIN dim_area d ON d.area_eic_code = e.area_eic_code AND d.is_current
    GROUP BY g.bucket
)
SELECT c.bucket,
    round(sum(z.wind_mw)) AS wind_mw, round(sum(z.wind_forecast_mw)) AS wind_forecast_mw,
    round(sum(z.solar_mw)) AS solar_mw, round(sum(z.solar_forecast_mw)) AS solar_forecast_mw,
    c.zones_reporting, c.zones_expected, c.zones_missing
FROM coverage c LEFT JOIN zone_buckets z USING (bucket)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY c.bucket
panels.description: Wind and solar generation against the ENTSO-E day-ahead forecast, summed over the zones and technologies publishing both.

panels.title: Generation mix
panels.sql:
WITH grid AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(
        time_bucket($bucket, $start_date::TIMESTAMP),
        $end_date::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL 1 DAY - INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND,
        $bucket
    )) AS bucket
),
tech_group AS (
    SELECT b.technology_code, g.name AS technology_group
    FROM bridge_technology_hierarchy b
    JOIN dim_technology g ON g.technology_code = b.ancestor_technology_code
    WHERE g.parent_technology_code IN ('renewable', 'fossil')
       OR (g.parent_technology_code IS NULL AND g.technology_code NOT IN ('renewable', 'fossil'))
),
series AS (
    SELECT time_bucket($bucket, g.timestamp_utc) AS bucket, g.area_eic_code,
        coalesce(tg.technology_group, 'Other') AS technology_group,
        avg(greatest(g.generation_mw, 0)) AS mw
    FROM mart_generation_actual g
    LEFT JOIN tech_group tg USING (technology_code)
    WHERE list_contains($areas, g.area_eic_code) AND g.timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND g.timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY bucket, g.area_eic_code, technology_group, g.source_dataset, g.source_code, g.border_area_eic_code
),
expected AS (SELECT DISTINCT area_eic_code FROM series),
coverage AS (
    SELECT g.bucket,
        count(p.area_eic_code) AS zones_reporting,
        count(*) AS zones_expected,
        string_agg(d.display_name, ', ' ORDER BY d.display_name) FILTER (WHERE p.area_eic_code IS NULL)
            AS zones_missing
    FROM grid g
    CROSS JOIN expected e
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT bucket, area_eic_code FROM series) p
        ON p.bucket = g.bucket AND p.area_eic_code = e.area_eic_code
    LEFT JOIN dim_area d ON d.area_eic_code = e.area_eic_code AND d.is_current
    GROUP BY g.bucket
),
-- groups under 2% of the total fold into Other
shares AS (
    SELECT technology_group, sum(mw) >= 0.02 * sum(sum(mw)) OVER () AS shown FROM series GROUP BY technology_group
),
mix AS (
    SELECT bucket, CASE WHEN shown THEN technology_group ELSE 'Other' END AS technology_group, round(sum(mw)) AS mw
    FROM series JOIN shares USING (technology_group) GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT c.bucket, m.technology_group, m.mw, c.zones_reporting, c.zones_expected, c.zones_missing
FROM coverage c LEFT JOIN mix m USING (bucket)
ORDER BY sum(m.mw) OVER (PARTITION BY m.technology_group) DESC NULLS LAST, m.technology_group, c.bucket
panels.description: Average generation by technology group (under 2% of the total folds into Other).

description: Price, demand, renewables and generation of the selected zones on one time axis; toggle panels in the header. Grey: some selected zones do not report (lighter) or none does (darker).

title: Zone summary
sql:
WITH zones AS (
    SELECT area_eic_code, display_name AS zone, long_name AS name
    FROM dim_area WHERE is_current AND is_bidding_zone
),
generation_series AS (
    SELECT g.area_eic_code,
        avg(greatest(g.generation_mw, 0)) AS mw,
        avg(CASE WHEN t.is_zero_carbon THEN greatest(g.generation_mw, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS zero_carbon_mw
    FROM mart_generation_actual g
    LEFT JOIN dim_technology t USING (technology_code)
    WHERE g.timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND g.timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY g.area_eic_code, g.source_dataset, g.source_code, g.border_area_eic_code
),
generation AS (
    SELECT area_eic_code, sum(mw) AS avg_generation_mw, sum(zero_carbon_mw) AS zero_carbon_mw
    FROM generation_series GROUP BY area_eic_code
),
demand AS (
    SELECT area_eic_code, sum(demand_mw * coverage) / sum(coverage) AS avg_demand_mw
    FROM mart_demand_actual WHERE timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY area_eic_code
),
price AS (
    SELECT area_eic_code, sum(price_per_mwh * coverage) / sum(coverage) AS day_ahead_price_eur
    FROM mart_energy_price WHERE source_dataset = 'ENTSOE_12.1.D' AND time_horizon = 'day_ahead' AND coalesce(classification_sequence, 1) = 1 AND currency = 'EUR' AND timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY area_eic_code
)
SELECT z.area_eic_code, z.zone, z.name,
    round(g.zero_carbon_mw / nullif(g.avg_generation_mw, 0) * 100, 1) AS zero_carbon_share_pct,
    round(d.avg_demand_mw) AS avg_demand_mw,
    round(g.avg_generation_mw) AS avg_generation_mw,
    round(p.day_ahead_price_eur, 2) AS day_ahead_price_eur
FROM zones z
LEFT JOIN generation g USING (area_eic_code)
LEFT JOIN demand d USING (area_eic_code)
LEFT JOIN price p USING (area_eic_code)
WHERE coalesce(g.avg_generation_mw, d.avg_demand_mw, p.day_ahead_price_eur) IS NOT NULL
  AND list_contains($areas, z.area_eic_code)
ORDER BY z.zone
description: Demand, generation, zero-carbon share and day-ahead price of each selected zone.

title: Demand forecast error by hour (UTC)
sql:
WITH paired AS (
    SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 HOUR, a.timestamp_utc) AS hour, a.area_eic_code,
        avg(a.demand_mw - f.demand_mw) AS error_mw
    FROM mart_demand_actual a
    JOIN mart_demand_forecast f
        ON f.timestamp_utc = a.timestamp_utc AND f.area_eic_code = a.area_eic_code AND f.time_horizon = 'day_ahead'
    WHERE list_contains($areas, a.area_eic_code) AND a.timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND a.timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY ALL
),
hourly AS (
    SELECT hour, sum(error_mw) AS error_mw FROM paired GROUP BY hour
    HAVING count(*) = (SELECT count(DISTINCT area_eic_code) FROM paired)
)
SELECT hour(hour) AS hour_utc, round(avg(error_mw)) AS avg_error_mw
FROM hourly GROUP BY hour_utc ORDER BY hour_utc
description: Mean day-ahead demand forecast error of the selected zones by hour of day (UTC).

title: Border capacity now
sql:
-- the current hour, or the last hour of the selected range when it ends before now
WITH now_hour AS (
    SELECT least(
        date_trunc('hour', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),
        $end_date::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL 23 HOUR
    ) AS hour_utc
),
zones AS (SELECT area_eic_code, display_name FROM dim_area WHERE is_current AND is_bidding_zone),
horizons AS (SELECT ['year_ahead', 'month_ahead', 'week_ahead', 'day_ahead'] AS by_recency),
borders AS (
    SELECT o.display_name || ' → ' || i.display_name AS border,
        arg_max(c.transfer_capacity_mw, list_position(h.by_recency, c.time_horizon)) AS now_mw,
        arg_max(c.time_horizon, list_position(h.by_recency, c.time_horizon)) AS now_horizon,
        max(c.transfer_capacity_mw) FILTER (WHERE c.time_horizon = 'month_ahead') AS month_ahead_mw
    FROM mart_transfer_capacity c
    JOIN now_hour n ON c.timestamp_utc = n.hour_utc
    JOIN zones o ON o.area_eic_code = c.out_area_eic_code
    JOIN zones i ON i.area_eic_code = c.in_area_eic_code
    CROSS JOIN horizons h
    WHERE c.source_dataset = 'ENTSOE_11.1.A'
        AND (list_contains($areas, c.out_area_eic_code) OR list_contains($areas, c.in_area_eic_code))
    GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT b.border,
    round(b.now_mw) AS now_mw,
    lower(t.name) AS now_from,
    round(b.month_ahead_mw) AS month_ahead_mw,
    round(100.0 * (b.now_mw - b.month_ahead_mw) / nullif(b.month_ahead_mw, 0), 1) AS change_pct
FROM borders b
JOIN dim_time_horizon t ON t.time_horizon = b.now_horizon
ORDER BY change_pct NULLS LAST, b.border
description: Cross-border transfer capacity of the selected zones' borders in the current hour (or the last hour of the selected range): the level from the most recent horizon published for that hour (ENTSO-E day-ahead, else week-ahead), the month-ahead forecast for the same hour, and the change from it. Bidding zone to bidding zone; most reduced borders first.

title: Capacity vs month-ahead forecast
sql:
WITH grid AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(
        time_bucket($bucket, $start_date::TIMESTAMP),
        $end_date::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL 1 DAY - INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND,
        $bucket
    )) AS bucket
),
zones AS (SELECT area_eic_code, display_name FROM dim_area WHERE is_current AND is_bidding_zone),
horizons AS (SELECT ['year_ahead', 'month_ahead', 'week_ahead', 'day_ahead'] AS by_recency),
-- per border and hour: the most recent horizon published, and the month-ahead forecast
hourly AS (
    SELECT c.timestamp_utc, c.out_area_eic_code, c.in_area_eic_code,
        o.display_name || ' → ' || i.display_name AS border,
        arg_max(c.transfer_capacity_mw, list_position(h.by_recency, c.time_horizon)) AS latest_mw,
        max(c.transfer_capacity_mw) FILTER (WHERE c.time_horizon = 'month_ahead') AS month_ahead_mw
    FROM mart_transfer_capacity c
    JOIN zones o ON o.area_eic_code = c.out_area_eic_code
    JOIN zones i ON i.area_eic_code = c.in_area_eic_code
    CROSS JOIN horizons h
    WHERE c.source_dataset = 'ENTSOE_11.1.A'
        AND (list_contains($areas, c.out_area_eic_code) OR list_contains($areas, c.in_area_eic_code))
        AND c.timestamp_utc >= $start_date AND c.timestamp_utc < $end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY ALL
),
change AS (
    SELECT time_bucket($bucket, timestamp_utc) AS bucket, out_area_eic_code, in_area_eic_code, border,
        avg(100.0 * (latest_mw - month_ahead_mw) / nullif(month_ahead_mw, 0)) AS change_pct
    FROM hourly
    GROUP BY ALL
    HAVING count(month_ahead_mw) > 0
),
-- the borders between selected zones (up to six of them); otherwise the six most reduced against the
-- month-ahead forecast (also with no selection, when every zone counts as selected)
per_border AS (
    SELECT border,
        bool_or(list_contains($areas, out_area_eic_code) AND list_contains($areas, in_area_eic_code)) AS between_selected,
        avg(change_pct) AS mean_change_pct
    FROM change GROUP BY border
),
selection AS (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE between_selected) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AS few_between FROM per_border),
ranked AS (
    SELECT border, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY mean_change_pct, border) AS border_rank
    FROM per_border
    WHERE between_selected OR NOT (SELECT few_between FROM selection)
    QUALIFY border_rank <= 6
)
SELECT g.bucket, c.border, round(c.change_pct, 1) AS change_pct
FROM grid g
LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.*, r.border_rank FROM change c JOIN ranked r USING (border)) c USING (bucket)
ORDER BY c.border_rank NULLS LAST, g.bucket
description: Change of border capacity from its month-ahead forecast, in %: the most recent horizon published for each hour (ENTSO-E day-ahead, else week-ahead) against the month-ahead value for that hour; 0% = as forecast a month ahead. Month-ahead values are the expected minimum offered, so day-ahead often sits above them. Shows the borders between the selected zones (select two neighbours, e.g. GB and FR); otherwise, or when more than six, the six borders of the selection most reduced.

config.empty_message: No month-ahead capacity forecast for the borders of the selected zones.
